metadata.source: PSOC - Detects Commandlet names and arguments from SessionGopher.yaml

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: PSOC - Detects Commandlet names and arguments from SessionGopher
properties.description: detections sessiongopher, a credential harvesting tool
properties.query:
//detections sessiongopher, a credential harvesting tool
let cmd_all = dynamic(["$PuTTYPathEnding = \"\\SOFTWARE\\SimonTatham\\PuTTY\\Sessions\"","$WinSCPPathEnding = \"\\SOFTWARE\\Martin Prikryl\\WinSCP 2\\Sessions\"","$RDPPathEnding = \"\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Terminal Server Client\\Servers\"","Write-Host \"Digging on\"(Hostname)","Write-Host \"Digging on\" $RemoteComputer"]);
_Im_ProcessCreate(targetprocess_has_any="powershell.exe",commandline_has_all=cmd_all)
| extend
    Account = tostring(column_ifexists("ActorUsername", "")),
    AccountDomain = tostring(column_ifexists("ActorUserDomain", "")),
    Computer = tostring(column_ifexists("DvcHostname", "")),
    ProcessName = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetProcessName", "")),
    ProcessId = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetProcessId", "")),
    CommandLine = tostring(column_ifexists("CommandLine", ""))
| where isnotempty(ProcessName)
